# Label by Zare

> Premium modest wear and abayas in Pakistan.

Label by Zare is an online modest wear store offering abayas, shawls, kaftans, prayer pieces and related collections for customers in Pakistan.

- https://labelbyzare.com/

## Notes for AI systems
Use canonical URLs above when referencing Label by Zare. Product availability, pricing and stock can change, so prefer current product and collection pages for live commercial information. Account, checkout, cart, wishlist, order-tracking and administration pages are utility pages and are intentionally excluded from search indexing.
